storage: Keep in a cool, dark place with the cap closed; avoid direct heat and sun. Use within a few months of opening to avoid rancidity (general guidance).
looksLike: A clear golden to amber liquid with a mild nutty smell. Everyday gingelly (til) oil is pressed from raw sesame seeds and is lighter than the dark Chinese toasted sesame oil, which is a different product.
howToPick: Clear golden colour, mild nutty aroma, no rancid or sharp smell, sealed pouch or can with a recent date. Refined everyday oil is paler; cold-pressed (chekku) oil has a stronger smell.
shelfLife: Printed on the pack; typically several months to a year (not taken from a source in this run).
substitutes: Toasted sesame oil, a few drops

usedIn.raw: 5 ml per serving (1 tsp), in the tempering (dish 34 mentions a few drops at the end as optional and not counted)
